crossRefs.note: David saved neither man nor woman alive, to bring them to Gath, saying, “Lest they should tell about us, saying, ‘David…
Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.
Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

people.name: Gedaliah
people.line: Appointed governor of Judah by Babylonians; assassinated by Ishmael.

translations.web: The second day after he had killed Gedaliah, and no man knew it,
translations.bsb: On the second day after the murder of Gedaliah, when no one yet knew about it,
translations.kjv: And it came to pass the second day after he had slain Gedaliah, and no man knew
